plugin.plugin_voicetext.name: Voice Text Link
plugin.plugin_voicetext.description: Opens a text channel for the members of a voice channel: linked channels or a temporary text channel per voice channel.
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.links_hi: Whoever is in the voice channel sees the text channel; leaving the voice channel hides it again. Make the text channel hidden for @everyone yourself.
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.auto_hin: Voice channels without a link get a hidden text channel on the first join, next to the voice channel; only the members in the voice channel see it.
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.auto_cha: Only for these voice channels or categories
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.auto_nam: {voice} is the name of the voice channel, {user} the member who came first.
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.auto_del: Delete it when the voice channel is empty
plugin.plugin_voicetext.setting.greeting: Posted into the text channel; {user} mentions the member, {voice} is the voice channel. Empty: no message.
